title: Instrument statistics
description: instrument-stats/<venue>: a snapshot on subscribe, then changed rows where the venue streams them. Volume is quote notional and change is percent. Match hedge instrument ids after removing :long or :short. For volume and change, null means no figure has been received; retain a previous figure if known. Optional invalidate names figures to clear explicitly, including after a stream or subscription gap; absent keeps the legacy null-retains-previous behavior.

lastPrice.description: Last traded price in quote, where the exchange sends it. Absent retains the previous price for compatibility; explicit null clears it.

invalidate.description: Clear only these figures; omitted retains previous figures for null values as before.
